layout_shaped_context.status: shape only; not a certified indexed layout or executable literal

native_probe.method: Thumb-1 BL shapes at every halfword alignment to the independently discovered map lookup, last BL targets in five setter-handler intervals, and checksum-verified prior native wrappers. Previous 32 bytes inspected only for MOVS and PC-relative LDR constant shapes; no register/control-flow analysis. Raw BL shapes can occur in data; indirect calls, computed IDs and RAM writes are outside this probe.

handler_comparison.method: Independent adjacent-NOP code search and little-endian handler-prefix references. Contained candidates are treated as interior positions, not separate tables. Compared code intervals stop at next known handler or 256 bytes. This does not verify dispatcher use, complete function boundaries, helper/native callees, or runtime state.
